what: EII (feature extern_item_impls) in hir-def attrs, for 00843: rustc's has_custom_linkage counts CodegenFnAttrFlags::EXTERNALLY_IMPLEMENTABLE_ITEM (an #[eii] implementation) as an extern indicator. hir-def has no EII attribute at all (rg -i eii crates/hir-def finds nothing), so no item can be one. Asked: an AttrFlags bit (or query) for an item that implements an EII, as rustc sets it from AttributeKind::EiiImpls; then codegen keeps it in crates/hir-ty-codegen/v2/roots/kept.rs keeps_function/keeps_static beside custom_linkage. Tell codegen its name.
